_doc: Vektor NO.099: the state file schema, shown with one ticker and the weight change from our second replay run on Claude Fable 5.2 (2026-11-11, paper money, not advice). The agent appends one entry to runs on every run and never edits earlier runs; your own script fills what_happened_next from real closing prices after the fact. Field names are the ones our run used.

what_happened_next._doc: Filled in by your script from real closing prices, never by the agent.

weight_change.trigger: TSLA: earnings_surprise score 80 (+9.1% surprise) in run-1, then -6.79% from the 2026-10-27 close to the 2026-11-10 close.
weight_change.balancing_entry: free_cash_flow raised from 0.25 to 0.30 so the four weights still sum to 1.0.
weight_change.reason: One strong-surprise pick (TSLA, score 80) fell 6.79% while its free cash flow was shrinking, so a beat counts a little less and cash flow a little more; this is one observation over two weeks, not proof.
weight_change.evidence_against: Three of the four names with a surprise score of 80 or more rose (GE +13.52%, PG +5.92%, NFLX +1.18%), which is why the step is 0.05 and no larger.
